text: The cast of the new play meets in the hall each week.
translation: 新剧的演员阵容每周在礼堂碰头。
note: the cast 作集体名词，指全部演员；后面 meet 的是「人」不是「物」，排除投掷/铸件。

text: A good cast can make a very simple story feel real.
translation: 好的演员阵容能让一个很简单的故事显得真实。
note: cast 与 story 并列，宾语是故事而不是被投掷的东西。

text: Every member of the cast learned all the lines by heart.
translation: 每一位演员都把全部台词背得滚瓜烂熟。
note: member + lines（台词）只可能用于演员阵容。

text: The whole cast sang the last song together at the very end.
translation: 全体演员在最后一起唱了最后一首歌。
note: whole cast + sang，排除投掷（投掷不与唱歌同句）。

text: Her name was in the cast list printed in the paper.
translation: 报纸上印的演员表里有她的名字。
note: cast list 是固定搭配，等于中文的「演员表」。

text: He cast the small stone far out into the water and waited.
translation: 他把小石子远远抛进水里，然后等着。
note: 宾语 stone 可抛；cast 在此是 throw 的过去式。

text: The old men cast their nets into the sea at dawn.
translation: 老渔夫们在黎明时把网撒进海里。
note: net + into the sea 是「投出去」的典型场景，非演员阵容。

text: She cast a line into the river and then pulled hard.
translation: 她把钓线甩进河里，然后用力拉。
note: cast a line 是固定搭配，与 fishing 场景绑定。

text: Each voter cast one paper into the box near the door.
translation: 每位选民把一张选票投进门边的箱子里。
note: cast a paper/ballot 与 vote 同句；虽然涉及选举，但动作本身是「投」。

text: The boy cast the small white ball up against the wall.
translation: 男孩把小白球朝墙上抛去。
note: 球被抛出且方向明确；对比 s3 的铸件是被动的「铸件」。

text: The wheel fell off because one cast in it was broken.
translation: 轮子掉了，因为里面有一个铸件裂了。
note: cast 作名词，指铸成的金属部件；in it 说明它是嵌在轮子里的零件。

text: They put a new metal cast into the machine last Friday.
translation: 他们上周五往机器里装了一个新的金属铸件。
note: metal + machine 的替换件，是工厂语境。

text: This iron cast is too heavy for one man to lift.
translation: 这个铁铸件太重了，一个人搬不动。
note: iron + heavy + lift：铸件是实体零件，不是被投出的东西。

text: A broken cast in the frame stopped the whole line.
translation: 框架里一个铸件断了，整条生产线停了。
note: frame + line（生产线），典型铸造车间场景。

text: He melted the old cast and made a new small one.
translation: 他把旧铸件熔掉，重新做了一个小的。
note: melt（熔化）只能作用于金属铸件，最强的判别词。

text: The old man cast serious doubt on the whole new plan.
translation: 老人对这个新计划提出了严重的质疑。
note: cast doubt on 是固定搭配；宾语是抽象的「怀疑」不是实体。

text: Many people cast doubt on the news of the deal.
translation: 许多人对这笔交易的消息表示怀疑。
note: cast doubt on + news，同 s1 是抽象义，与 s2/s3 的实物宾语分开。

text: The late result cast doubt on all the earlier tests.
translation: 这个迟来的结果让所有早先的检测都受到怀疑。
note: cast doubt on 搭配；若无 on 直接接宾语则不是本义。

text: Please do not cast doubt on the work of honest men.
translation: 请不要对老实人的工作表示怀疑。
note: cast doubt on 搭配，语义是「使人产生怀疑」。

text: The new facts cast doubt on the old story at once.
translation: 新出现的事实立刻让旧说法站不住脚了。
note: cast doubt on 搭配；facts/story 都是抽象名词。
